# BLS fixture provenance

Both fixtures are trimmed real responses captured 2026-07-13 from the official BLS
Public Data API v2 without a registration key. `laus.json` is series
`LAUCN484530000000003`; `qcew.json` was refreshed live with series
`ENU4845310010` (all employees, all ownership, total industries) and retains
2019, 2020, 2024, and 2025 points to exercise the five-year calculation.
